title: Product of square-integrable real functions is integrable
statement: Use $\mathbf R$ [def-weil-field]. Let $m\geq1$ be an integer and use Lebesgue measure on $\mathbf R^m$. Let $a,b:\mathbf R^m\to\mathbf R$ be measurable functions such that $\int |a(\xi)|^2\,d\xi<\infty$ and $\int |b(\xi)|^2\,d\xi<\infty$. Then their pointwise product is integrable: $$\int_{\mathbf R^m}|a(\xi)b(\xi)|\,d\xi<\infty.$$
